description: This PHP file defines the WorkWeekAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving and updating work week configurations in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching a specific work week by ID, updating the work week days, and managing validation rules. The class uses traits and models to facilitate data handling and transformation.

classes.name: WorkWeekAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing work week schedules, including fetching and updating weekly work configurations. Implements resource endpoint interface and uses traits for business logic.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific WorkWeek entity by ID, returning it in the appropriate model format based on query parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the work week configuration for a given ID with provided daily values, then returns the updated model.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines which data model class to use based on the request query parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' operation, primarily checking the ID and model parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'update' operation, including validation for daily work week values.

methods.description: Deletion is not implemented; calling this will throw an exception.

methods.description: Validation for delete operation is not implemented; calling this will throw an exception.
